structuredContent.content:
name: Li Yu Dao static checks

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - 'mod_li_yu_dao/**'
      - 'tools/extract_auto_upgrade_buildings.py'
      - 'docs/li-yu-dao/acceptance/2026-10-04-R0002-native-cycles-formal-red/**'
      - '.github/workflows/li-yu-dao-static.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'mod_li_yu_dao/**'
      - 'tools/extract_auto_upgrade_buildings.py'
      - 'docs/li-yu-dao/acceptance/2026-10-04-R0002-native-cycles-formal-red/**'
      - '.github/workflows/li-yu-dao-static.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  static:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Check generated content and runtime
        run: |
          python mod_li_yu_dao/tools/gen_content.py --check
          python mod_li_yu_dao/tools/gen_runtime.py --check
      - name: Check product and builder
        run: |
          python mod_li_yu_dao/tools/validate_static.py --report /tmp/lyd-static.json
          python mod_li_yu_dao/tools/test_build_release.py
          python mod_li_yu_dao/tools/test_run_acceptance.py
          python mod_li_yu_dao/tools/test_school_consent.py
          python mod_li_yu_dao/tools/test_content_leadership.py
          python mod_li_yu_dao/tools/build_release.py --check
      - name: Preserve static report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: li-yu-dao-static-report
          path: /tmp/lyd-static.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
